description: Hey, I'm Rohan Gowda. I'm passionate about conneting Space-Medicine-Engineering together by creating health monitoring web applications to help Astronauts during their space missions
summary: SpaceHealth is an educational web-based astronaut health monitoring dashboard designed to demonstrate how crew health information can be organised and monitored during long-duration space missions. It allows users to enter health measurements, view health indicators, track historical readings through charts, receive illustrative health status alerts, and record psychological wellness check-ins. The goal is to demonstrate how a centralised digital dashboard could support awareness of astronaut health during space exploration.
details:
SpaceHealth – Astronaut Health Monitoring Dashboard

The Problem

Astronauts on long-duration space missions face several health challenges due to the space environment. Monitoring their physical and psychological well-being is important for supporting crew health and mission safety.

Our Solution

SpaceHealth is an educational web-based dashboard that demonstrates how astronaut health information can be monitored and organised in one place.

The dashboard allows users to:

  • Enter heart rate, blood pressure, body temperature and glucose readings.
  • View health indicators classified as Normal, Get Checked or Critical.
  • Monitor health trends using interactive charts.
  • View previous health readings in an activity history.
  • Receive alerts when readings cross illustrative thresholds.
  • Record psychological wellness through mood check-ins.
  • View crew member profile and mission progress information.

How It Works

Users enter health measurements through a form. JavaScript processes the readings and updates the dashboard, charts, status indicators and health history. Browser local storage helps retain the information between visits.

Technology Used

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chart.js and browser local storage.

Creativity and Impact

SpaceHealth combines physical health indicators, historical trends, alerts and psychological wellness in a single dashboard. It demonstrates how a centralised monitoring interface could help organise crew health information during future space missions.

Limitations

This is an educational prototype. Its thresholds and sample readings are illustrative, not official NASA medical standards. It is not a medically validated device and does not diagnose health conditions.
